verdict.rationale: Missive's docs say you can connect Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, or IMAP accounts (missive-docs-71). Gmail gets full two-way sync with labels (missive-docs-72), and IMAP/SMTP servers with untrusted certificates are supported (missive-docs-63). Everything is managed in one inbox (missive-docs-73), and per-account sharing lets you configure who sees what (missive-docs-74). Missing for 10: hands-on or community corroboration of running several mixed-provider accounts side by side, and Microsoft 365 mail detail beyond the 'Outlook, Exchange' mention (missive-docs-23 shows only Office 365 contact sync).
